title: Redemption is slow
text: I've been using this app for two years. Everything's working fine, but its processing speed is very slow. Whenever I want to redeem money, it takes five days for the money to be credited.

title: Goal-wise tracking
text: Cumulative investing is not easy to track when investors have multiple financial goals. It would be great if the app introduced goal-wise trackers with sub-divisions for goals like retirement, education, wealth creation, etc.

title: F&O page after login
text: Initially, I thought it was happening only with my phone, but later I discovered that everyone else was facing the issue with the latest app update.

title: Trade execution gets stuck
text: Your app gets stuck far too often at the time of trade execution, and even after setting a profit/loss limit, the order does not get executed automatically.

title: Account frozen during ReKYC
text: I have been locked out of my own investments due to a ReKYC process. My account is still completely frozen with a systemic error.

title: Withdrawal pending
text: Withdrawal status stays pending for too long and I cannot see a clear expected credit time.

title: Portfolio loading
text: Portfolio takes a few seconds to load after opening the app.

title: Support follow-up
text: Support asked me to repeat the same details instead of showing ticket progress.

title: Simple dashboard
text: The dashboard is easy to understand and I can find my holdings quickly.

title: Notifications
text: Trade notifications sometimes arrive later than expected.

title: SIP tracking
text: SIP details are easy to find but goal tracking could be more detailed.

title: Order status
text: After placing an order, the status does not always update immediately.

title: Beginner friendly
text: The interface is simple and the main actions are easy to understand.

title: App crash
text: The app occasionally closes while moving between portfolio screens.

title: KYC status
text: I would like a clearer view of where my verification is in the process.

title: Support delay
text: It took too long to get a useful response from support.

title: Clean interface
text: The app is straightforward and portfolio information is easy to find.

title: Slow loading
text: Screens can take a long time to load during busy market periods.

title: Mutual fund filters
text: More filters would make it easier to compare mutual funds.

title: Order retry
text: When an order fails, I want a clearer retry option.

title: Goal buckets
text: Goal-based buckets would make long-term investing easier to follow.

title: Withdrawal tracking
text: I want a clearer timeline for withdrawals.

title: Account navigation
text: Account settings are easy to find but some screens feel crowded.

title: Support ticket
text: Ticket updates are not clear enough.

title: Easy investing
text: Buying a mutual fund was straightforward.

title: Charts
text: Charts sometimes take time to load.

title: SIP reminders
text: SIP reminders are useful but I would like more notification controls.

title: Login issue
text: I had to retry login several times before getting into the app.

title: Portfolio view
text: The portfolio summary is clear and useful.

title: Trade confirmation
text: Trade confirmation should appear faster.

title: Search
text: Searching for stocks is straightforward.
